benchmark.setup: Build both packages separately using command in pair script plus --no-run before measurement; baseline already had artifacts. Dist profile, production RUSTFLAGS and build-std, panic-abort-tests. Five interleaved base/candidate pairs for each package; rustybench CLI 0.4.0 and library 0.5.0. The script exits on any failed pre, run or immediate post gate.
benchmark.script:
#!/bin/zsh
set -u
root="$PWD"
for package in diff-pretty scrl; do
  for iteration in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    for side in base candidate; do
      if [ "$side" = base ]; then tree="$root/../ds-perf-base"; else tree="$root"; fi
      label="${package}-${iteration}-${side}"
      cd "$tree" || exit 1
      uptime > "$root/.work/tmp/${label}.load"
      sysctl -n hw.ncpu >> "$root/.work/tmp/${label}.load"
      perf-gate-ready > "$root/.work/tmp/${label}.pre" 2>&1
      pre=$?
      if [ "$pre" -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s pre=%s\n' "$label" "$pre"; exit 50; fi
      env CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$PWD/.work/perf-abort-target" TMPDIR="$PWD/.work/tmp" RUSTC_WRAPPER=kache CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 CARGO_TARGET_AARCH64_APPLE_DARWIN_LINKER=clang RUSTFLAGS='-Zlocation-detail=none -Zunstable-options -Cpanic=immediate-abort -Clink-arg=-Wl,-dead_strip_dylibs' cpu-guard --cores 2 -- rustybench baseline --baseline "$root/.work/tmp/${label}.json" --warmup 1 --runs 1 --sample-count 5 --sample-size 10 -- cargo bench -p "$package" --bench bench --profile dist -Z build-std=std -Z build-std-features= -Z panic-abort-tests --target aarch64-apple-darwin > "$root/.work/tmp/${label}.log" 2>&1
      run=$?
      perf-gate-ready -1 > "$root/.work/tmp/${label}.post" 2>&1
      post=$?
      printf '%s pre=%s run=%s post=%s\n' "$label" "$pre" "$run" "$post"
      if [ "$post" -ne 0 ]; then exit 51; fi
      if [ "$run" -ne 0 ]; then exit 52; fi
    done
  done
done
